name: docmind
description: Azure AI Foundry RAG app — chunking, embeddings, vector search, tool calling

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
